name: Stock Summary Advanced
report_script:
columns = [
    {
        "fieldname": "item_group",
        "label": _("Item Group"),
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "Item Group",
        "width": 180
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "item_code",
        "label": _("Item Code"),
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "Item",
        "width": 150
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "item_name",
        "label": _("Item Name"),
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "width": 220
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "stock_uom",
        "label": _("UOM"),
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "UOM",
        "width": 100
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "opening_qty",
        "label": _("Opening Qty"),
        "fieldtype": "Float",
        "width": 130
    }
]


filters = filters or {}


query = """
    SELECT

        i.item_group AS item_group,

        sle.item_code AS item_code,

        i.item_name AS item_name,

        i.stock_uom AS stock_uom,


        CASE
            WHEN %(report_type)s = 'By Project'
            THEN sle.warehouse
            ELSE ''
        END AS warehouse,


        /*
            ERPNext Stock Balance concept:

            Opening Qty = stock balance immediately
            before the From Date.

            Company mode:
            Calculate the cumulative stock balance
            for the item across the company.

            By Project mode:
            Calculate the cumulative stock balance
            for the item in the selected warehouse.
        */

        CASE

            WHEN %(report_type)s = 'Company' THEN

                COALESCE(

                    (
                        SELECT
                            SUM(opening_sle.actual_qty)

                        FROM
                            `tabStock Ledger Entry` opening_sle

                        WHERE

                            opening_sle.item_code =
                                sle.item_code

                            AND opening_sle.company =
                                %(company)s

                            AND opening_sle.is_cancelled = 0

                            AND opening_sle.docstatus < 2

                            AND opening_sle.posting_date <
                                %(from_date)s
                    ),

                    0
                )


            ELSE

                COALESCE(

                    (
                        SELECT
                            opening_sle.qty_after_transaction

                        FROM
                            `tabStock Ledger Entry` opening_sle

                        WHERE

                            opening_sle.item_code =
                                sle.item_code

                            AND opening_sle.warehouse =
                                sle.warehouse

                            AND opening_sle.company =
                                %(company)s

                            AND opening_sle.is_cancelled = 0

                            AND opening_sle.docstatus < 2

                            AND opening_sle.posting_date <
                                %(from_date)s

                        ORDER BY

                            opening_sle.posting_date DESC,

                            opening_sle.posting_time DESC,

                            opening_sle.creation DESC

                        LIMIT 1
                    ),

                    0
                )

        END AS opening_qty


    FROM

        `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle


    INNER JOIN

        `tabItem` i

        ON i.name = sle.item_code


    WHERE

        sle.posting_date BETWEEN
            %(from_date)s
            AND %(to_date)s

        AND sle.is_cancelled = 0

        AND sle.docstatus < 2

        AND sle.company = %(company)s


        /*
            Item
        */

        AND (
            %(item_code)s IS NULL

            OR %(item_code)s = ''

            OR sle.item_code = %(item_code)s
        )


        /*
            Item Group
            Include selected Item Group
            and all child Item Groups.
        */

        AND (

            %(item_group)s IS NULL

            OR %(item_group)s = ''

            OR i.item_group IN (

                SELECT
                    child_group.name

                FROM
                    `tabItem Group` child_group

                WHERE

                    child_group.lft >= (

                        SELECT
                            parent_group.lft

                        FROM
                            `tabItem Group` parent_group

                        WHERE
                            parent_group.name =
                                %(item_group)s
                    )

                    AND child_group.rgt <= (

                        SELECT
                            parent_group.rgt

                        FROM
                            `tabItem Group` parent_group

                        WHERE
                            parent_group.name =
                                %(item_group)s
                    )
            )
        )


        /*
            Warehouse only applies
            to By Project.
        */

        AND (

            %(report_type)s = 'Company'

            OR %(warehouse)s IS NULL

            OR %(warehouse)s = ''

            OR sle.warehouse = %(warehouse)s
        )


    GROUP BY

        i.item_group,

        sle.item_code,

        i.item_name,

        i.stock_uom,

        CASE
            WHEN %(report_type)s = 'By Project'
            THEN sle.warehouse
            ELSE ''
        END


    ORDER BY

        i.item_group ASC,

        sle.item_code ASC,

        sle.warehouse ASC
"""


query_filters = {
    "company": filters.get("company"),
    "report_type": filters.get("report_type"),
    "warehouse": filters.get("warehouse"),
    "item_group": filters.get("item_group"),
    "item_code": filters.get("item_code"),
    "from_date": filters.get("from_date"),
    "to_date": filters.get("to_date")
}


data = frappe.db.sql(
    query,
    query_filters,
    as_dict=True
)


if filters.get("report_type") == "By Project":

    columns.insert(
        4,
        {
            "fieldname": "warehouse",
            "label": _("Project / Warehouse"),
            "fieldtype": "Link",
            "options": "Warehouse",
            "width": 220
        }
    )


data = columns, data
